facts.F2: The particulars of offence are that Cen Qiusheng, between a day unknown in June, 2016, and 31 August, 2016, both dates inclusive, in Hong Kong or elsewhere, conspired with a person known as Chen Mingyuan to deal with property, namely money deposited in account numbered 124-466905-833
facts.F3: In June 2016, a Singaporean female and a Malaysian female were deceived into transferring sums of USD1,000 and USD3,000 respectively to the HSBC bank account opened by Mr Cen
facts.F4: On 15 June 2016, Mr Cen opened the HSBC bank account, and he was the only designated user
facts.F5: The opening mandate claimed that the purpose of the account was for Mr Cen's frequent travel to Hong Kong and to have an account for expenses in Hong Kong
facts.F6: Transaction records of the HSBC account show that during the period from the account opening date to 31 August 2016, the total amount of deposits in USD was USD631,019.04 (approx HKD4,921,948.51) and the total amount of deposits in HKD was HKD217,036.89
facts.F7: All or most of the USD received into the account was converted into HKD and transferred into the HKD sub-account within a short space of time, and then further transferred to the Hang Seng Bank accounts of two companies known as Kwok Wai and Long Sing
facts.F8: On 13 February 2017, Mr Cen was arrested at Lo Wu Control Point when he entered Hong Kong
facts.F9: Mr Cen's travel record shows that he entered Hong Kong at 1538 hours on 15 June 2016 and exited at 1917 hours the same day, and had no further movement record until 13 February 2017
facts.F10: Hang Seng Bank records show that Kwok Wai had Mainland connections and that Long Sing shared the same registered address as Kwok Wai
facts.F11: Mr Cen has a clear criminal record in Hong Kong
facts.F12: Mr Cen is 49, born and lived alone in the Mainland; he had been a merchant; he is divorced, and a holder of an Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau
facts.F13: A sentencing starting point of 4 years' imprisonment was adopted by the court
facts.F14: A 1/3 discount was applied to the defendant's sentence due to his early plea

facts.F1: The defendant opened an account with the Bank of China on 13 March 2002 and was the sole signatory of the account
